scope: Focused literature, source-code comparison and exact planning chapter; not MR02 or frontier-census acceptance

reviewed.anchor: Developed connected argument with target, clock and alternatives

plan_review.anchor: Declared scope and matched acquisition comparison

criteria.finding: Five inspected primary works compare favorable and adverse results; three pinned software sources have concrete reuse/deferral decisions and unresolved full implementations remain explicit.

Fee-waiver target and two clocks are stated; full-world versus decision information, all-attempt costs, correlated errors, finite-horizon stopping and omitted support are developed and independently checked.
Published benchmarks are attributed, new numbers are stipulated exact planning results, and no live model, vendor, package or bank performance is claimed.

substantive_checks: Full-world EIG is explicitly distinguished from information about H; no general claim that information design fails.
Costs and terminal values share normalized deployment units; no measured ROI or calibrated signal accuracy.
Stopping optimality is restricted to the declared menu and horizon at most two.
DISCERN levels are independently instantiated; rubric percentages are not discovery probabilities.
MDA matched-evaluable results and compute limits are not generalized to all attempts.
Benchmark source interfaces and parser fallbacks are inspected without execution; overview repository is not an executable implementation.
Secondary account of the therapeutic case does not validate an uninspected biomedical original.
Unavailable original routes and candidate identities remain in the omissions register.
